PR46.body:
## 目的 / Purpose
根据用户确认的 [PR #44 统一 UI 设计](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/44)，直接升级正式 M1 Lite 页面（不是概念原型）。从开发基线 `f117cf3ca512a4ca7e1eec505b5e28744159343f` 创建独立开发候选，不改 main。

Based on the approved design PR #44, update actual M1 Lite UX while retaining all validated business logic.

### 已实施 / Implemented
- **报价回收**：导入方式聚焦切换（全部/文件/粘贴/单条）、紧凑默认列 / 完整列、逐条详情；“刷新显示”检测正在使用的导入/沿用预览，拒绝潜在破坏性重绘，其他情况下仅重绘并保留输入与滚动。
- **Quote intake**: Focusable input modes, compact/full columns, line details, and guarded view-only refresh.
- **比价议价**：决策概览→范围→逐物料表→金额分析；冗长规则折叠、报价单元格的交期/MOQ/轮次与商务条款改为按需展开、隐藏正式模式下重复的“历史采购价未接入”列，新增纯视图“仅看待决定”。
- **Comparison**: Decision-first layout, scoped analytics, secondary quote detail disclosures and pending-only view filter.
- **工作区/图纸/报表**：状态归并为一个简洁入口，技术日志按需展开；业务导出与数据恢复在管理区分组；图纸匹配步骤可见。
- **Workspace**: Compact status, separate report grouping and visible drawing-step guidance.

### 保护范围 / Safety
未改动 SQLite schema、报价轮次/版本计算、最低价并列及人工定标条件、Excel/PDF 内容、供应商隔离、S4 后端恢复规则。只修改正式 UI 及添加一个新的测试文件，不删除或修改既有测试/CI。

No persisted model, quote calculation, award logic, ZIP/PDF, exporter or S4 backend changes.

### 测试与门槛 / Validation gate
新增真实 Chromium + 隔离 SQLite E2E：录入方式切换、导入预览刷新保护、价单元格详情、紧凑模式、比较筛选、保存状态和数据管理分组。PR 创建后运行原 UI Unified / S3-S4 GitHub Actions 自动测试，**任何 CI 失败必须由 ChatGPT 排查修复；未通过前不交 Codex Cloud**。

When the exact final HEAD is CI-green, request one independent scoped TEST-ONLY Codex business/visual run (no full C03-C09 repetition). Keep this PR Draft, do not merge into baseline/main before independent acceptance and explicit owner approval.

## Follow-up to d7c4c88 E2E failures — fix candidate, not yet retested

Latest product/test HEAD: `fbb98944a4bcee439e4e81ebfe3ef710bee4a3d0` (PR #46 remains Draft/open; no merge). Evidence basis: [Codex exact-SHA report](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/blob/0c4e08a82ac5835d088c93cb9d82424bd3065bcd/docs/uat/20261029-pr46-d7c4c88-tooltip-restore-retest/REPORT.zh-CN.md).

Changes on the actual PR #46 branch:
- Aligned final `--bg` and `--srm-canvas` tokens with the approved V3.1 `#F6F8FB` background. The integration test's expected approved token is unchanged.
- Updated the malformed-ZIP E2E assertion to the current buyer-facing “完整备份恢复未完成” copy. The test still checks that no `RESTORE_*` code leaks and the restore target remains empty.
- Replaced every supplier-first whole-row click in `acceptance.spec.cjs` with a click on the supplier-name `<b>` element. This prevents the row-center click from landing on the nested “移出本次询价” button; existing selection/title, RFQ isolation, export/download, and dirty-state assertions remain.

Static checks: 9 product inline scripts and 5 affected E2E files parse; all 407 DOM IDs remain unique. No browser tests have been run on this new SHA.

The first independent `#runAssignSearch` timeout remains **ROOT CAUSE UNKNOWN**. The retained log only says Playwright resolved the button and waited for it to be visible/enabled/stable; there is no frame-by-frame geometry/overlay trace to justify a product fix. No forced click or timeout increase was added. Retest exact SHA `fbb98944a4bcee439e4e81ebfe3ef710bee4a3d0`; if it recurs, capture consecutive-frame bounding boxes, computed styles/active animations, scroll, focus/hover, `elementFromPoint`, obstruction, screenshot and trace. If it does not recur, record “not reproduced,” not “root cause fixed.”

No Actions triggered (`[skip ci]`), no CI change, no merge/closure, no main change. Previous `d7c4c88` 107 PASS/5 FAIL does not transfer. Windows-native three groups remain NOT TESTED.

## New exact product SHA for independent TEST-ONLY retest

Please keep the existing `d7c4c88` report immutable. ChatGPT has prepared a new candidate on PR #46 at exact HEAD `fbb98944a4bcee439e4e81ebfe3ef710bee4a3d0`.

Re-run the full Python/Node/Chromium suite on this exact SHA with isolated synthetic data. Focus on: (1) malformed ZIP displays current buyer copy and still rejects safely with no `RESTORE_*` leakage and unchanged target; (2) supplier-first tests select via supplier-name element and no longer accidentally activate the nested removal button, while retaining RFQ-isolation, export/download/content and dirty-state assertions; (3) approved `#F6F8FB` V3.1 canvas token; (4) full regression, tooltip bounds, restore security, save/quote history and 1366×768 first-row visibility.

**Independent first-click timeout diagnostic:** prior trace only records `#runAssignSearch` resolving while Playwright waits for visible/enabled/stable. If it recurs, preserve first failure and instrument consecutive animation-frame bounding boxes, computed style and active animations, scrollY, focus/hover, `elementFromPoint`, overlay/hit target, screenshot and trace. Do not force-click, raise the timeout, hide the failure with retries, or claim the original root cause fixed if it does not reproduce.

Append new evidence under a fresh directory in this existing Draft PR #50; do not overwrite old reports. TEST-ONLY only: do not modify product code, tests or CI during the test run; do not dispatch Actions, merge or close PRs. Windows-native three groups remain NOT TESTED if no real Windows environment is available. No previous-SHA results transfer.
